digest.component_or_area: BindingStore facade and repository persistence layer
propositions: BindingStore facade must delegate persistence operations to BindingRepository without changing public imports, constructor signatures, or method contracts
BindingStore pending/confirmed/reverse lookup and shallow all_bindings() behavior must remain unchanged after extracting repository persistence
Facade save/reload must produce identical bytes and preserve all exception behavior versus direct repository operations
BindingRepository must remain internal to the facade; no caller should receive writable repository access
Existing peer_state.py and get_rotation.py ownership and rotation/retirement ordering semantics must be preserved through the delegation
